**The Mission:**
----------------


As Kong accelerates toward an IPO and the next stage of enterprise growth, finance systems must evolve from operational tools into strategic business enablers. We are seeking a visionary Finance Systems leader to define the strategy, architecture, and execution of our financial technology ecosystem. In this role, you will build a scalable, resilient, and AI\-powered finance platform that delivers trusted data, streamlined operations, and the controls required to support a world\-class public company.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* Own the strategy, administration, and long\-term roadmap for our core finance systems, including **NetSuite, Celigo, Brex, Pigment, and Zip**, ensuring reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Design, build, and govern mission\-critical integrations across the enterprise ecosystem—including **Salesforce, Workday, Ashby**, and other business applications—to ensure accurate, timely, and seamless data flow.
* Establish best\-in\-class governance, controls, and monitoring to maintain data integrity, strengthen audit readiness, and ensure SOX\-compliant financial processes.
* Champion AI\-driven transformation within Finance by designing intelligent automations that eliminate manual work, improve reporting accuracy, and accelerate business decision\-making.
* Partner closely with Accounting, FP\&A, Revenue Operations, HR, and IT to translate evolving business requirements into scalable systems and process solutions.
* Lead enterprise\-wide finance systems initiatives—including implementations, upgrades, migrations, and vendor evaluations—from strategy through successful deployment and adoption.
* Drive operational excellence by managing a robust support model with defined SLAs, proactive issue resolution, and strong strategic partnerships with key technology vendors.
* Continuously optimize the finance technology landscape by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience, and enable business growth.

**What You'll Bring:**
----------------------


### **Experience**


* 12\+ years of progressive experience leading Finance Systems in high\-growth SaaS organizations, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise financial platforms.
* Proven success scaling finance systems through rapid growth, ideally supporting organizations from **$100M to $750M\+ ARR**, including both pre\-IPO and public company environments.
* Deep hands\-on expertise administering **NetSuite** and modern integration platforms such as **Celigo, Workato, or Boomi**.
* Strong experience implementing and integrating finance applications across **ERP, FP\&A, spend management, procurement, CRM, and HRIS** platforms, including tools such as **Brex, Pigment (or Anaplan), Zip, Salesforce, and Workday**.
* Demonstrated success designing and delivering AI\-powered automation solutions that drive measurable improvements in finance operations, rather than simply adopting AI tools.
* Strong SQL and analytical skills, with the ability to independently investigate data issues, validate system outputs, and ensure financial data accuracy.
* A strategic mindset combined with hands\-on technical expertise, capable of balancing long\-term architecture with day\-to\-day operational excellence.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence executives and collaborate across Finance, IT, and business teams.

\#LI\-NS1

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. title: Manager, Project Finance
description:
**Key Responsibilities — Project Financial Management (60%)**

* Act as the financial co\-pilot to Project Managers for an assigned portfolio, providing proactive financial guidance and translating project economics into actionable operational decisions.
* Provide accurate, transparent and timely financial and non\-financial analysis to support project and portfolio decision\-making.
* Own and communicate the financial outlook for assigned projects, including revenue, profitability, cost performance, cash flow, forecast accuracy and key financial risks and opportunities.
* Clearly articulate the financial implications of business decisions and provide both retrospective analysis and forward\-looking recommendations for complex projects and contract types.
* Facilitate the monthly revenue and forecasting cycle for assigned projects, including review of units, forecast assumptions, unit prices, revenue recognition and alignment of the financial forecast with operational plans.
* Complete meaningful variance analysis, identify root causes and work with project leadership to establish corrective actions, recovery plans and risk mitigation where needed.
* Evaluate project and portfolio performance independently, escalate material financial concerns and partner with appropriate stakeholders to drive timely remediation.
* Build strong relationships with Project Managers, Functional Leads, Service Line Leads, Business Unit leaders and Finance partners and serve as a trusted advisor on project financial performance.  



**Key Responsibilities — India Analyst Team Leadership (40%)**

* Coordinate analyst workload and priorities across supported business units, balancing capacity, deadlines, complexity and business needs to ensure effective coverage.
* Create clear expectations for analyst responsibilities, deliverables, quality standards and turnaround times, and monitor execution against those expectations.
* Review analyst work and provide guidance on complex financial issues, project analysis, forecasting, variance explanations and escalation of risks.
* Develop analyst capabilities in project finance management so the team can progressively operate with greater independence, business acumen and ownership.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one discussions, provide timely feedback, support development planning and contribute to performance and career management.
* Promote consistent processes and ways of working across the India team while maintaining effective partnership with Associate Directors and other PFM leaders supporting different business units.

This role is responsible for maintaining farm\-level financial discipline and operational cost tracking across multiple managed farms. The candidate will ensure that every farm operates with structured financial visibility and accurate expense control.

**Farm\-Level Financial Tracking**

* Record and manage farm\-wise expenses (Ex. Like A–J farm clusters)

* Labour cost
* Seed \& material cost
* Fertilizer / input cost
* Operational expenses

* Assist in farm budgeting and cost planning
